levels.name: organelle
levels.is: one weight unit: a trunk, an adapter, an evidence head or a router head

levels.name: cell
levels.is: one model (trunk + adapter, or a whole small model) with its evidence head; one dragon name

levels.name: tissue
levels.is: cells that share one trunk; they share its weights, tokenizer and lower-layer pass

levels.name: organ
levels.is: cells on one job, with at least one witness from a different lineage

levels.name: organism
levels.is: one device's Tiamat: one chiglet's body

levels.name: species
levels.is: every device on the same profile and pack

levels.name: environment
levels.is: devices on the mesh, sharing finished jobs and server organs under both owners' grants

evidence.rule: Every cell answers through its evidence head (kernel/src/tensor/zt_evh.h): mu = evidence for, lambda = evidence against, mapped to TRUE, FALSE, BOTH or NEITHER. Organs combine verdicts with lpres_conjoin and lpres_disjoin, so grouping order never changes the verdict and a contradiction (BOTH) is never averaged away.
evidence.witness_rule: A TRUE or FALSE verdict an organ reports needs a witness cell from a different lineage (different trunk or different developer). Same-trunk agreement counts as one witness.
evidence.native_training: tools/tiamat/server/train_tfbn.py fits each cell's head on four-valued data (probe mode) and trains K/V-safe adapters with a four-way loss (adapter mode).

voice_of_tiamat.job: dialogue with the owner, routing in

herald.router_head: fitted on Indexserpent embeddings (docs/AI_MODEL.md section 5) until Toolhatchling's engine path lands

arbiter.job: contradiction, argument and fallacy checks; the swarm's verifier

voice.job: speech out; speaks only when tapped

hand.job: robot arms; logistics and mapping only, human-approved

clerk.job: regulatory and legal reading; advisory only, never legal advice

profiles._rule: One config scales by profile. A profile lists the placements it loads; cells load lazily when an organ needs them and are paged out first-in by least surplus. Budgets are resident model bytes, leaving the rest of RAM to the OS and apps.

device_tiers._note: Pioneer, Vanguard, Sovereign and Citadel are on GitHub (hardware/docs/oem); the other personal devices and all six servers are mapped by memory class until their specs land.

isf._rule: kernel/src/surplus: members are picked by the most interaction surplus F (a near-copy of a member adds nothing); a level grows only while surplus_can_grow holds (Paper E reserve Q(t+1) = (1 - delta) Q(t) + eta S(t) - C(t)); hobby and routing weights move under the Lipschitz cap.
isf.split: Fibonacci: a level's budget F(n) splits into its two children's F(n-1) and F(n-2), exactly, all the way down to cells.
isf.routing_score: surplus gained per token: (F(team with cell) - F(team without)) / expected tokens, ties broken by the cell's hobby tilt, never by its verdict.

cross_wiring._rule: Each time a configuration is set, Tiamat wires the chosen cells together so no work is done twice, then measures what that saved against running them apart (tools/tiamat/server/bench_crosswire.py). Only exact sharing is used: two cells share a computation only when they would compute the same bits.

shared.how: one read-only base, one adapter per cell (zt_lora, T23)

shared.when: cells with the same tokenizer (all Qwen2.5 cells)
shared.how: tokenise once, Venn job table key (model family, context hash)

shared.when: cells in one tissue whose adapters start at or above the split layer
shared.how: run layers below the split once, fork the state, run each cell's upper layers. Exact because nothing below the split differs. Needs the engine's state fork (server task S7).
Indexserpent embeds each document once; every cell and the router reuse it

shared.when: any two agents asking the same question of the same model on the same context
shared.how: kernel/src/swarm/swarm_overlap.h (V1 to V3): one run, cost split exactly

cross_wiring.split_layer: per tissue, the lowest layer every member's adapter can start at while it still passes its quality gate (set by extract_adapters.py, recorded in the DNA)
cross_wiring.never_shared: verdicts: each witness reasons on its own, or the paraconsistent join would count one opinion twice

reconfiguration._rule: Adaptive and smart configuration are built in. Cells regroup into organs and organisms by task, device profile and ISF budget, within resource limits.
triggers: a cell fails its health check
steps: propose: rank candidate groupings by routing_score within the profile's budget
check: the arbiter replays a held-out probe set on the new grouping; it must not lose accuracy or raise BOTH-to-TRUE errors
watch: if surplus falls below the old configuration's for a window, roll back automatically
reconfiguration.journal: every reconfiguration is a signed entry (old config hash, new config hash, reason, measured surplus before and after); any entry can be rolled back to its old config
reconfiguration.new_species: a grouping becomes a new species only after the checker passes it and the owner approves

dna._status: Field list proposed; the encoding is agreed with the 'Two-way genomic DNA encoding' thread through the coordinator.
records: organism composition: for each cell its dragon name, model id, revision, shipped sha256, adapter sha256, evidence head sha256
parent DNA hash (for agents a chiglet creates)

hobbies.assign: tools/tiamat/assign_dna_hobbies.py: deterministic from the DNA seed, unique within an agency
hobbies.bounds: hobbies spend only the growth budget, tilt proposals and break ties, never touch verdicts; drift past the DNA's Lipschitz cap resets the member and is journalled
